default.$description: Primary action default — button fill, link colour, active nav indicator. Light: royalBlue/700. Dark: royalBlue/600.

hover.$description: Primary action hover — darken on pointer-over. Light: royalBlue/600. Dark: royalBlue/600.

click.$description: Primary action pressed — deepest shade on mouse-down. Light: royalBlue/800. Dark: royalBlue/800.

subtle.$description: Primary action subtle — soft accent for selected rows and active states. Light: royalBlue/500. Dark: royalBlue/400.

subtlest.$description: Primary action subtlest — lightest tint for hover backgrounds and focus areas. Light: royalBlue/100. Dark: royalBlue/900.

visited.$description: Visited link colour. Light: royalBlue/800. Dark: royalBlue/300.

default.$description: Secondary action default — ghost button border and text. Light: royalBlue/700.

hover.$description: Secondary action hover background. Light: royalBlue/100.

click.$description: Secondary action pressed background. Light: royalBlue/200.

default.$description: Destructive action — delete, irreversible operations

hover.$description: Destructive action hover — darker red for delete/danger button hover state.

click.$description: Destructive action pressed — deepest red for delete/danger button mouse-down.

default.$description: Neutral action default — tertiary button resting state. Transparent surface.

hover.$description: Neutral action hover — subtle grey fill on pointer-over.

active.$description: Neutral action active/pressed — slightly deeper grey on mouse-down.

default.$description: Accent action color for secondary interactive elements — distinct from primary action.

hover.$description: Accent action color on hover state.

default.$description: Primary text — body copy, headings. Light: neutral/900. Dark: neutral/100.

subtle.$description: Secondary text — metadata, supporting labels. Light: neutral/700. Dark: neutral/400.

subtlest.$description: Tertiary text — placeholders, disabled labels. Light: neutral/600. Dark: neutral/500.

disabled.$description: Disabled text — non-interactive labels. Light: neutral/500. Dark: neutral/600.

purple.$description: Purple accent text — for beta and accent labels. Pending Brand collection migration.

success.$description: Success text — for status labels and success messages on light backgrounds. Light: freshGreen/800. Dark: freshGreen/400.

warning.$description: Warning text — for warning labels on light backgrounds. Light: honeyAmber/800. Dark: honeyAmber/400.

information.$description: Information/brand text — for info labels and branded accent text. Light: royalBlue/800. Dark: royalBlue/400.

selected.$description: Text color for selected items — e.g. selected table rows, active nav items.

subtle.$description: Inverse subtle text — secondary text on dark surfaces (toast actions). Light: neutral/800. Dark: neutral/300.

subtlest.$description: Inverse subtlest text — tertiary text on dark surfaces (toast hover actions). Light: neutral/700. Dark: neutral/400.

$root.$description: Inverse text — white text on dark surfaces (toasts, dark nav). Light: neutral/0. Dark: neutral/900.

default.$description: Default page/canvas background. Light: neutral/0. Dark: neutral/900.

muted.$description: Muted surface — disabled backgrounds and skeleton loaders. Light: neutral/200. Dark: neutral/700.

sunken.$description: Recessed surface — below default elevation (wells, code blocks). Light: neutral/300. Dark: neutral/800.

disabled.$description: Disabled surface background — for non-interactive panels and containers.

inverse.$description: Inverse surface — dark surface on light mode (toasts, dark tooltips). Light: neutral/900. Dark: neutral/0.

overlay.$description: Overlay surface — modal and dialog backgrounds. Light: neutral/0. Dark: neutral/800.

empty.$description: Background surface for empty state containers.

subtle.$description: Purple subtle surface — light purple background. Pending Brand collection migration.

bold.$description: Purple bold surface — dark purple background. Pending Brand collection migration.

default.$description: Default border/divider — input borders, separators, card outlines. Light: neutral/300. Dark: neutral/600.

subtle.$description: Subtle border — lighter dividers, inner separators. Light: neutral/200. Dark: neutral/700.

bold.$description: Bold border — strong emphasis borders. Heavier than line/default.

disabled.$description: Disabled border — for non-interactive field outlines.

default.$description: Success fill — green badge background, status dot. Light: freshGreen/600.

subtlest.$description: Success subtle — light green chip and alert background. Light: freshGreen/300.

hover.$description: Success status — background hover state on success badges and chips. Aliases color/freshGreen/400.

selected.$description: Success status — selected/pressed text and icon fill. Aliases color/freshGreen/900.

default.$description: Warning fill — amber badge background, status dot. Light: honeyAmber/600.

subtlest.$description: Warning subtle — light amber chip and alert background. Light: honeyAmber/300.

hover.$description: Warning status — background hover state. Aliases color/honeyAmber/400.

selected.$description: Warning status — selected/pressed fill. Aliases color/honeyAmber/900.

default.$description: Neutral status color — used for inactive or default status labels.

subtlest.$description: Neutral status subtlest background — used for inactive or default status chips and alerts. Aliases color/neutral/200.

hover.$description: Neutral status — background hover state. Aliases color/neutral/400.

selected.$description: Neutral status — selected/pressed fill. Aliases color/neutral/900.

default.$description: New readonly chip — icon and text fill. Aliases color/royalBlue/700.

subtlest.$description: New readonly chip — background fill. Aliases color/royalBlue/200.

default.$description: Tutorial readonly chip — icon and text fill. Aliases color/neutral/700.

subtlest.$description: Tutorial readonly chip — background fill. Aliases color/neutral/200.

default.$description: Beta readonly chip — icon and text fill. Aliases color/purple/700.

subtlest.$description: Beta readonly chip — background fill. Aliases color/purple/200.

default.$description: Danger fill — red badge background, error border. Light: tartRed/600.

subtlest.$description: Danger subtle — light red chip and alert background. Light: tartRed/300.

hover.$description: Danger status — background hover state. Aliases color/tartRed/400.

selected.$description: Danger status — selected/pressed fill. Aliases color/tartRed/900.

default.$description: Information fill — blue badge background. Light: royalBlue/600.

subtlest.$description: Information subtle — light blue chip and alert background. Light: royalBlue/200.

hover.$description: Information status — background hover state. Aliases color/royalBlue/400.

selected.$description: Information status — selected/pressed fill. Aliases color/royalBlue/900.

default.$description: Link default colour. Aliases color/royalBlue/700.
Selection highlight — text selection background. Light: royalBlue/200.

hover.$description: Selection hover — background tint when hovering over a selectable item.

active.$description: Selection active — background for currently active/focused selectable item.

mark.$description: Selection mark colour — checkmark or tick inside a selected control.

default.$description: Control default border. Light: neutral/400.

focus.$description: Control focus border — border colour when checkbox/radio has keyboard focus.

invalid.$description: Control invalid border — border colour when checkbox/radio has a validation error.

default.$description: Control (checkbox, radio) default background. Light: neutral/0.

bg.$description: Background color for file uploader drop zone on hover.

border.$description: Border color for file uploader drop zone on hover.

focus.$description: Focus ring shadow — blue glow on interactive elements. 0 0 0 3px rgba(3,105,233,0.25).

selected.$description: Selected state shadow — softer blue glow. 0 0 0 2px rgba(3,105,233,0.20).

default.$description: Semantic shadow colour alias — points to shadow/base primitive. Use in component drop shadows.

xlarge.$description: Extra large icons — colour status, upload, empty state

default.$description: Default icon colour. Aliases color/neutral/700.

subtle.$description: Subtle icon colour — secondary/supporting icons. Light: neutral/600. Dark: neutral/400.

selected.$description: Icon colour — selected/active state. Aliases color/royalBlue/700.

inverse.$description: Inverse icon colour — icons on dark surfaces. Light: neutral/0.

disabled.$description: Disabled icon colour. Light: neutral/400. Dark: neutral/600.

hover.$description: Icon colour — hover state. Aliases color/neutral/800.
